newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: SOCCER-MANNINGER TRAINS WITH ARSENAL AHEAD OF POSSIBLE TRANSFER.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-MANNINGER TRAINS WITH ARSENAL AHEAD OF POSSIBLE TRANSFER.

text.p: Alexander Manninger, goalkeeper of Austria's Casino Graz, had a trial training session at English premier league side Arsenal on Monday.
The Austrian news agency APA said Casino Graz manager Peter Svetits would meet Arsenal's French coach Arsene Wenger on Tuesday to discuss Manninger's possible transfer to the London club.
Casino Graz are reported to want approximately $1 million for the 19-year-old Manninger, who has a contract with the first division side until 2001.
APA said Wenger was impressed with Manninger's training performance on Monday. Arsenal goalkeepers David Seaman and John Lukic are currently both out of action with injuries.
Manninger became Casino Graz's number one goalkeeper last October after a brilliant performance in a UEFA Cup match against Italy's Inter Milan at the San Siro stadium.
In that match, Manninger was a last-minute replacement for regular goalkeeper Franz Almer who fell ill just before the encounter.
